newsitem.title: FRANCE: France urges peace moves after Jerusalem bombing.
newsitem.headline: France urges peace moves after Jerusalem bombing.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac sent condolences to Israel on Wednesday after a bomb attack in a Jewish west Jerusalem market killed at least 18 people, and called for a resumption of the peace process.

"Terrorism and violence should be strongly condemned. Only the resumption of the peace process, which is necessary and urgent, can open the way to a future for all peoples of the region," Chirac said in a letter to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
Voicing his "feelings of sadness and solidarity", Chirac asked Netanyahu "to send my personal condolences and those of the French people to the victims' families".
